results.name: The Hamalayi (against LBA1)
notes: LBA1's Hamalayi is eight separate exterior scenes (each a 64 × 64-cell grid, 55 m square) with no common map: the coast IoU and the landmarks have nothing to align to. Scored here: walkable area (as the coast part) and the heights of the walkable ground above its lowest level (as the height part). Our Hamalayi's places (Lhar, the lift, the monastery, the observatory) are ours: no LBA1 counterpart to place.
